## Hypothesis

The base strategy (without any additional candidates) already meets the walk-forward OOS Sharpe >=0.70 threshold, has real-fills on the top 3 J days within 20% of BS-sim, and incurs <=10% edge_capture reduction on the 3 PUT winners. This candidate proposes to validate these claims via a dedicated walk-forward OOS run on 16-month OPRA data.

## Mechanism

No change to the engine logic. This quality gate is always enabled (i.e., it does not filter any trades). It serves as a vehicle to run the validation tests specified in the task.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure 1)
2. **Sample bias:** 16-month OPRA data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) used for walk-forward OOS; selection method is time-based (walk-forward windows); overfit risk mitigated by requiring sub-window stability and out-of-sample validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (to be filled after walk-forward OOS run)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (to be filled after validating top 3 J days vs BS-sim)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest; Max drawdown: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest; Blow-up scenario: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X)

## Pre-merge gate

- Walk-forward OOS on 16-month OPRA data must show Sharpe >=0.70.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) must show <=20% deviation vs BS-sim.
- Edge_capture reduction on the 3 PUT winners must be <=10%.
- All gym validators must pass.
- Real-fills replay must be conducted on the top 3 J days.

5 / 10 -- We have not yet run the walk-forward OOS or real-fills validation; this candidate is a proposal to run those tests.
